verdict.rationale: Foreloop collects user feedback, and a per-submission agent drafts intentions and tasks from each report. Its CLI/MCP lets external agents read Foreloop data, but that is a developer building block, not a documented assistant for querying feedback themes. Nothing in the evidence covers aggregating feedback into themes or linking feedback to revenue impact.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can ask an AI assistant questions about customer feedback themes and their revenue impact
